metaTitle: Simon Says — meeting minutes that write themselves
metaDescription: Put a laptop on the meeting table and press Start. Simon Says writes decisions and tasks live into your association's own Google Doc. No audio is stored. Free for associations.
heroText: Put a laptop on the meeting table and press Start. While you talk, Simon Says writes the minutes into your association's own Google Doc: decisions, who does what and by when.
freeLine: Free for associations. No audio is stored.
orgTitle: Before, during and after the meeting
orgText: Not just notes. Simon Says helps the board with the whole week around the meeting.
beforeText: The agenda is ready in a minute. Last week's tasks are already listed under From last week.
duringText: Every task gets Who, When and Done when. If you have old minutes, Simon Says learns your format.
afterText: Whoever wasn't there gets the summary by email. Everyone sees their own tasks under My tasks.
privatTitle: Record the lecture. Get the summary by email.
privatText: Record a lecture or a conversation yourself. Afterwards you get a summary with what mattered and your tasks. Sort recordings by context, a course for example, so everything stays together. Only you see them.
privatPoint3: Tasks and decisions in one place
step1Text: Create the association and invite the board with a link. Or start right away in Personal.
step2Text: Everyone in the room is told the meeting is being written down. The laptop's microphone is enough, and nobody else needs an account.
step3Text: When the meeting ends, everything is in the document, the summary has been emailed and the tasks are with the right people.
trust1Text: The audio becomes text while you talk. No recording is stored, and the pause button stops everything at once.
trust2Text: It lives in your association's Google Drive. Simon Says never changes what you write yourselves.
trust3Text: We may only open documents Simon Says created itself. We don't see the rest of your Drive.
trust4Text: What is stored, where and for how long is in the <link>privacy information</link>.
openLine: Open source on <repo>GitHub</repo>. How the service is doing right now is on the <status>status page</status>.
closeText: Sign in, create the association and put the laptop on the table.
demoLabel: Example: a meeting document being filled in during the meeting
demoCaption: Example. This is what the document looks like while you talk. Notes are written in the meeting's language (Swedish for now).
